info.name: Sez Print APIs
info.description:
All HTTP APIs in the sez-print repo, grouped by who calls them:

1. **Mobile App API** — admin server routes the Expo app uses (bearer token).
2. **Admin Desk API** — admin panel routes (session cookie).
3. **Print Service** — local Express backend on :8787.

Set `adminUsername` / `adminPassword` in the environment, start `admin` (`npm run dev`) and/or `backend`. Requests that create something save its id into a collection variable for the next request.

item.name: 1. Mobile App API
item.description:
Endpoints the Expo app calls on the admin server (`{{adminUrl}}`). CORS enabled.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer {{appToken}}` — the Login / Register requests save the token automatically.
Every request carries the x-app-* headers (set in collection variables).

item.name: Auth & OTP
item.description:
Register flow: Send OTP (register) → Verify OTP → Register.
OTP login flow: Send OTP (login) → Verify OTP (purpose login) → Login with OTP.

item.name: 2. Admin Desk API
item.description:
Admin panel endpoints on `{{adminUrl}}`.

Auth: run **Auth → Login** first. It sets the `sez_session` cookie, which Postman keeps in its cookie jar for localhost and sends on every later request. Everything here except Login and Health returns 401 without it.
Most routes also check a role permission (e.g. users.view, catalog.edit).

request.description: Matches ADMIN_FIXED_USERNAME / ADMIN_FIXED_PASSWORD from admin/.env. 8 misses → 429 for 15 min. Sets the sez_session cookie.
Current admin + role.
